recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio portrait of four young men standing in a row against a white background, heavily layered with black marker-style doodles and vibrant red spray-paint streaks that cross over both the subjects and the environment.
coreVisualRelationships: Doodles interacting with physical subjects (e.g., wings on shoulders, horns on heads)
Red spray paint acting as a disruptive horizontal band across the composition
High-key studio lighting contrasting with raw, messy graphic elements
Hand-drawn typography integrated into a central cloud-like doodle
coreInvariants: Direct eye contact or candid interaction among subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four full-body figures centered horizontally, occupying the middle two-thirds of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A central red circle with black tally marks located just above the subjects' heads.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye follows the red spray paint line from left to right, punctuated by the various doodles and the central red focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The white background is filled with dense, chaotic doodles, leaving little true negative space but maintaining a bright overall value.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White (background) and Black (doodles and clothing) provide the primary structure.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Red serves as the high-energy contrast, appearing in spray paint and a central graphic.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted tones in clothing (plaid, grey, denim) ground the image.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value background with high-saturation red accents and deep black shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Blocky, uppercase characters for primary text
Loose, gestural script for secondary text
Text contained within doodle-drawn boxes or clouds
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters within black boxes are reversed (white on black)
The letter 'O' in secondary text is often replaced or stylized as a simple circle
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A mix of heavy, boxed block lettering and thin, scratchy handwriting for a 'notebook' feel.

preserve: The 'reversed' look of text inside black blocks

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the thick, felt-tip aesthetic of the main title.
Captures the energy of the peripheral doodles.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast studio photo of four young men in casual punk-inspired clothing (plaid, denim) against a white wall. Add horizontal streaks of red spray paint across their torsos and the background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply black marker-style doodles including wings, horns, arrows, and a central cloud. Inside the cloud, add hand-drawn block lettering in white on black rectangular backgrounds.

verificationChecks: Does the red spray paint appear to sit on top of the subjects?
Are the doodles consistent in line weight?
Is the central red circle a primary focal point?
Is the text legible despite the hand-drawn style?

adjustableVariables: Specific doodle motifs (e.g., changing wings to halos)
postGenerationChecks: Check for 'ink bleed' edges on black lines
Ensure red spray paint has a soft, atomized edge
Verify that doodles interact with the subjects' poses
Confirm the white background remains bright and clean
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Studio Portrait] + [Marker Doodle Overlay] + [Spray Paint Accents] + [Reversed Block Typography] to create a [Punk-Pop] aesthetic.
